targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket_start AS time, sum(bytes) * 8 / 300 AS bits_per_sec
FROM flow_poc.flow_rollup_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Observed Traffic Throughput — 5m Duration-Aware Rollup
panels.description: Traffic throughput from flow_rollup_5m: sum(bytes) * 8 / 300. Uses the standardized duration-aware 5m rollup to avoid flow export/receive-time artifacts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY dst_name, dst_addr ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT received_at, src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, src_port, dst_port, bytes, packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, count() / 30 AS flows_per_sec FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Flow Records/sec — Ingest Telemetry
panels.description: Collector/exporter telemetry based on received_at. Spikes here indicate export or ingest batching, not traffic-volume spikes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, sum(packets) / 300 AS packets_per_sec FROM flow_poc.flow_rollup_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Packets/sec — 5m Duration-Aware Rollup
panels.description: Packets/sec from duration-aware flow_rollup_5m: sum(packets) / 300. This avoids raw received_at export batching artifacts from long-lived flows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_name AS device, src_addr, src_device_type, src_vendor, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.31.')) GROUP BY device, src_addr, src_device_type, src_vendor ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT dst_port, proto, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY dst_port, proto ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT bucket_start AS time, sum(bytes) * 8 / 300 AS bits_per_sec
FROM flow_poc.flow_conversation_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start)
  AND proto='UDP'
  AND service_port=443
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: UDP/443 QUIC Throughput — 5m Duration-Aware Rollup
panels.description: UDP/443 throughput from flow_conversation_5m using service_port=443. Uses the standardized duration-aware 5m conversation rollup to include both directions and avoid raw-flow timing artifacts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ip, name AS device, device_type, vendor, network, source, last_seen FROM flow_poc.device_inventory_current ORDER BY ip

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.31.')) AND NOT (startsWith(dst_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.31.')) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, count() / 30 AS rows_per_sec FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: ClickHouse Rows/sec — Ingest Telemetry
panels.description: ClickHouse ingest cadence based on received_at. This is pipeline telemetry and is intentionally not a traffic-volume rollup.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, countDistinct(sampler_address) AS exporters FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Exporter Count — Collector Telemetry
panels.description: Exporter visibility by receive window. This is collector telemetry and may vary with export cadence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.31.')) AND NOT (startsWith(dst_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.31.')) AND dst_port NOT IN (80,443,53,123,22) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, src_port, dst_port, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (src_port=22 OR dst_port=22) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, src_port, dst_port ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25
